description: Source code for a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' implementing a multi-step process for generating, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions using AI models, vector stores, and image analysis.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: Implements nodes for question generation workflow, including context retrieval, question creation, validation, and citation addition.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes AI client, embedding manager, image processor, vector store, storage, and caches.

methods.name: _get_cached_questions
methods.description: Retrieves questions with caching to reduce disk I/O.

methods.name: _calculate_question_similarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: _extract_medical_terms
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: _is_question_unique
methods.description: Checks if a question is unique based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: _extract_covered_topics
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions for context avoidance.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores
methods.description: Tracks quality scores for source chunks to prioritize high-quality content.

methods.name: retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context from vector store with smart selection based on coverage and diversity.

methods.name: generate_question
methods.description: Generates a new question using GPT-4, incorporating context and image analysis.

methods.name: validate_accuracy
methods.description: Validates question accuracy, quality, and uniqueness via AI.

methods.name: add_citations
methods.description: Finalizes question with source citations and updates quality metrics.
